Games.Title: Games
Games.Heading: Your games
Games.Subtitle: Check your games' DualSense support and available mods. Install a mod and review its setup steps.
Games.AddFolderTitle: Pick a folder where you keep games
Games.CustomFolderHint: A folder you added: {0}. It is read on every refresh; Forget folder drops it from the list and touches no game.
Games.Scanning: Reading Steam, Epic, GOG, Ubisoft, Xbox and the Windows registry…
Games.Footer: Compatibility data: PCGamingWiki (CC BY-NC-SA) · MadSense mod catalog {0} · Each mod belongs to its author
Games.NoGames:

Add a folder or search again after connecting the game's drive.
Games.EmptyDescription: Add the folder where you keep your games. You can also install a game from your store, then select Find games.
Games.Feature.speaker: Speaker
Games.ConnectionModes: Connection the game recognises: {0}. With MadSense the game sees a USB DualSense.
Games.WikiAttribution: Source: PCGamingWiki, written by its editors (CC BY-NC-SA). What the game does on your PC may differ.
Games.NoWikiData: PCGamingWiki has no page for this game, or the edition could not be confirmed.
Games.WikiBlocked: PCGamingWiki has limited lookups. Try Find games again in a minute.
Games.NativeHint: No mod needed: keep MadSense open, disable Steam Input for this game and the game drives the DualSense itself.
Games.NativeModHint: Works out of the box: keep MadSense open and disable Steam Input for this game. The mod takes priority only for the features it controls; the game retains the others.
Games.HelperRunning: The mod is running right now.
Games.HelperIdle: MadSense starts it when you open the game and stops it when you quit.
Games.InstallHelperHint: Install downloads the author's release, verifies it and keeps it in {0}. MadSense then starts it with the game.
Games.InstallGameFolderHint: Install downloads the author's release, verifies it and copies its files into the game folder without overwriting anything; Remove deletes only those files.
Games.InstallBeamNgHint: Install downloads the mod and drops it into the mods folder of your BeamNG.drive profile.
Games.ManualHint: MadSense cannot install this mod (download behind a login, or an external loader). Open its page; instead of DSX, keep MadSense open.
Games.NoModKnown: We know no DualSense mod for this game. If one exists, tell us on GitHub.
Games.Installed: {0} installed. Review the setup steps before playing.
Games.NotInstallable: This mod cannot be installed from MadSense.
Games.SizeMismatch: The downloaded file does not have the size the author published.
Games.HashMismatch: The file's digest does not match the one the author published. Not installed.
Games.NoExecutable: The package does not contain the expected executable.
Games.GameFolderMissing: The game folder cannot be found.
Games.BeamNgFolderMissing: The BeamNG.drive profile folder cannot be found; open the game once.
Games.UnsafePackage: The package tries to write outside its folder. Not installed.
Games.WouldOverwrite: The package would overwrite a game file ({0}). Not installed.
Games.StartStep: Open the game and keep MadSense open.
Games.ManualStep: Open the author's page and follow the instructions to install the requirements and the mod.
Games.CheckStep: Check for incoming data; an open helper does not confirm effects on the controller.
Games.ModPriority: The mod takes priority for the features it controls; the game retains the others.
Games.DiagnosticUnavailable: Diagnostics available when MadSense is connected.
Games.EmptyFilteredHint: Change the filter or clear the search.
Games.HelperStarted: {0} started. Open the game and check for data.
Games.DiagBusy: Another program is using the mod connection. Close DSX or another receiver and check again.
Games.DiagScope: Overall receiver status; it does not identify the sending mod or confirm physical effects.
Games.Flow.InstallIntro: Click INSTALL. MadSense downloads and places the mod; then we review what the game needs.
Games.Flow.Manual: This mod needs external installation. Open MOD PAGE and follow its author’s guide. MadSense cannot install or verify its files.
Games.Flow.HelperLaunch: Keep MadSense open and launch the game. With “Start with game” enabled, MadSense starts the mod’s program automatically.
Games.Flow.GameLaunch: Keep MadSense open and launch the game. The game loads the mod; restart it if it was open during installation.
Games.Flow.TryEffects: Enter gameplay and try the effects listed above. Receiving messages alone does not confirm that you feel the effect on the controller.
Games.Flow.NativePlay: Select DualSense mode in Controller, connect your controller and launch the game. No mod is needed.
Games.Flow.Steam: In Steam: Game Properties → Controller → Disable Steam Input.
Games.Flow.InstalledWarning: You have an installed mod. Viewing this screen does not disable it; manage it under VIEW OPTIONAL MODS.
Games.Flow.Connect: Connect your controller: press PS before testing.
Games.Flow.Busy: The effects connection is busy. Close other controller applications and reopen MadSense.
Games.Flow.Offline: The effects connection is not ready. Reopen MadSense.
Games.Flow.Receiving: Effects are arriving from a mod. We cannot identify which one; check the result in gameplay.
Games.Flow.Waiting: No effects yet. Enter gameplay; if this does not change, review PREPARE THE MOD.
